note.zh: 气象学研究完成：获得食物与金属泥潭矿藏。
note.en: The meteorology study ends with food and the metallic puddles deposit.

notes.zh: 审阅注：两条路线在此汇合——“禁止接触”经白银史莱姆、泥潭消失、银泥归来三步（每步35–75天）；“进一步调查”只经一步。研究项目需科研船与科学家，180天，1080天期限。
notes.en: Review note: both routes meet here — 'leave them alone' passes Silver Slime, Disappearing Puddles and Return of the Silver Slime (35–75 days each); 'investigate' takes one step. The project needs a science ship and scientist: 180 days, 1080-day limit.

scope.zh: 金属泥潭全部7个事件与气象学项目。
scope.en: All 7 Metallic Puddles events and the meteorology project.

note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.
